content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_11020 Caveats of GetCounterValue : Note that for counters of OsCounterType = HARDWARE the real timer value (the - possibly adjusted - hardware value, see [SWS_Os_00384]) is returned, whereas for counters of OsCounterType = SOFTWARE the current "software" tick value is returned.
